standard_prerequisites.name: Approximation of a flat finitely presented ring map by a flat finite type map of finite type Z-algebras
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the Noetherian-flavoured model A_0 -> B_0 whose base change is A -> B.

standard_prerequisites.name: A finite type ring map of Noetherian rings, or of finite type Z-algebras, is relatively pseudo-coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives pseudo-coherence of the approximating map.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of relative pseudo-coherence along tor independent ring maps

core_obligations: Let A -> B be a ring map which is flat and of finite presentation and note that B has finite tor dimension (proof lines 21820-21821).
Use the Algebra approximation statement to find a finite type Z-algebra A_0 contained in A and a flat finite type ring map A_0 -> B_0 with B = B_0 tensor_{A_0} A (proof lines 21822-21825).
Apply the Noetherian relative pseudo-coherence statement to conclude that A_0 -> B_0 is pseudo-coherent (proof lines 21825-21827).
Use flatness of A_0 -> B_0 to conclude that B_0 and A are tor independent over A_0 (proof lines 21828-21829).
Apply the base change statement for relative pseudo-coherence to conclude that A -> B is pseudo-coherent, which together with finite tor dimension gives perfectness (proof lines 21829-21831).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts in one line that a ring map which is flat and of finite presentation is perfect (source lines 21814-21817). The proof is a Noetherian-approximation argument. Let A -> B be flat and of finite presentation; it is clear that B has finite tor dimension (proof lines 21820-21821). By the Algebra approximation statement there exists a finite type Z-algebra A_0 contained in A and a flat finite type ring map A_0 -> B_0 such that B = B_0 tensor_{A_0} A (proof lines 21821-21825). By the Noetherian relative pseudo-coherence statement, A_0 -> B_0 is pseudo-coherent (proof lines 21825-21827). Since A_0 -> B_0 is flat, B_0 and A are tor independent over A_0, so the base change statement for relative pseudo-coherence applies and gives that A -> B is pseudo-coherent (proof lines 21828-21831). Together with finite tor dimension this is perfectness. The non-routine content is the reduction to the Noetherian case: every flat finitely presented map is a base change of a flat finite type map of finite type Z-algebras, and pseudo-coherence descends along tor independent base change.
